x-e-h2-04.s.s1.r.a: Zvinoitika mupfungwa dzemukuru wechikoro i fungidziro isingagone kusimbiswa nemunyori.
x-e-h2-04.s.s1.r.b: Izvi zvakaswedera pachokwadi chinogona kusimbiswa. Kana ukabvisawo ichi, musimboti wetsamba unoparara.
x-e-h2-04.s.s1.r.c: 'Nobody' inotaura nezvavanhu vese panguva imwechete uye inokanganwa vanhu vanotarisira.
x-e-h2-04.s.s1.r.d: Inoverengwa senjodzi, kwete chikumbiro, saka inoita kuti vaverengi vazvidzivirire.
x-e-h2-04.s.s1.explain: b i chokwadi chinofanira kusara. a (fungidziro nezvepfungwa dzemukuru), c (chirevo nezvavanhu vese) ne d (njodzi) i zvikamu zvichaoma kuvaverengi kuvimba nazvo.
x-e-h2-04.s.s2.prompt: Chengeta zvokwadi nechikumbiro, uye unyore patsva tsamba muChirungu kuvaverengi vepepanhau (vabereki, vadzidzisi nemukuru wechikoro). Shandisa mitsara 3 kusvika ku 5, uye usanganise dambudziko riri kutarisana neklabhu nechikumbiro chimwe chaicho.
x-e-h2-04.s.s2.hint.0: Tanga wanyora zvinhu zvitatu zvekubvisa padhirafiti nechinhu chimwe chekuchengeta.
x-e-h2-04.s.s2.hint.1: Mushure mechokwadi chawakachengeta, enderera nechikumbiro chaicho uchishandisa 'We would like ...' kana 'We ask ...'.
x-e-h2-04.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Unofunga kuti mukuru wechikoro angaiverenga asingazvidzivirire here?
x-e-h2-04.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Inosanganisira chokwadi, mhedzisiro yedambudziko, nechikumbiro here?
x-e-h2-04.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Chikumbiro chakajeka here (rini, zvakawanda sei, chii)?
x-e-h2-04.s.s2.modelNote.2: Chiitiko apo "nobody" yakashandiswa mukati memutsara wechokwadi.

x-e-h2-06.title: Kuverenga i-imeyili yetimu nekuwana mutsara unowana mhinduro 'Which meeting?'
x-e-h2-06.goal: Mudhirafiti ye-imeyili ichatumirwa nenhengo yetimu, wana mitsara inoita kuti anogamuchira abvunze zvakare, uye uinyore zvakare kuti anogamuchira aite pasina kubvunza zvakare.
x-e-h2-06.material:
Iyi idhirafiti ye-imeyili Sora yaanoda kutumira kutimu yose. Timu ine 'Sales Review Meeting' neMuvhuro pa10:00 ne 'Design Review Meeting' neChitatu pa15:00, uye iyo Sora anoda kutamisa imusangano weChitatu. Izvi nokuti murwi haachakwanisi kuuya.

Subject: Meeting
Hi all,
We need to move the meeting to next week because the client can't come.
Please tell me when you are free.
I'll book a room after that.
Sora
x-e-h2-06.thinking.0: Kuwana zvisina kujeka kubva pamaonero anogamuchira
x-e-h2-06.thinking.2: Kunyora subject, muviri nenguva yekupedza zvinoenderana
x-e-h2-06.prereq.1: Mataurirwo enguva yekupedza akaita sa by Friday
x-e-h2-06.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza mutsara mumwe unogona kuita kuti nhengo dzetimu dzibvunze zvakare shure kwekuverenga, sa "What meeting is this?" kana "By when do I reply?" (Kunyange kana pane mitsara yakawanda yakadaro, unongoda kusarudza mumwe wayo.)
x-e-h2-06.s.s1.hint.0: Fungidzira kana nhengo yetimu inogamuchira i-imeyili iyi kekutanga ingabvunza zvakare "So what?" nezvemutsara upi neupi.
x-e-h2-06.s.s1.hint.1: Verenga mutsara wega wega uye ubvunze, 'Saka ndinofanira kuita chii, uye pakazosvika rinhi?'
x-e-h2-06.s.s1.explain: Mutsara 1 (subject) nemutsara 3 hazvitaure kuti musangano upi, uye mutsara 4 hauna nguva yekupedza yekupindura. Sezvo pane misangano miviri, 'the meeting' oga haitaure kuti upi.
x-e-h2-06.s.s2.prompt: Nyora zvakare i-imeyili muEnglish, uchisanganisira subject (Subject). Ita kuti ioneke kuti musangano upi, chikonzero, zvaunokumbira, nenguva yekupedza yekupindura. (Mashoko anenge 60)
x-e-h2-06.s.s2.hint.0: Tanga wanyora mutsara mumwe pachimwe nechimwe che subject, chikonzero, chikumbiro nenguva yekupedza, wobva waubatanidza.
x-e-h2-06.s.s2.hint.1: Ongorora sechecklist kana wakanyora 'musangano upi' ne 'pakazosvika rinhi.'
x-e-h2-06.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Munhu anogamuchira i-imeyili kekutanga angapindura pakarepo pasina kubvunza zvakare here?
x-e-h2-06.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Unogona kuziva kuti i-imeyili inotaura nezvei kubva pa subject oga here?
x-e-h2-06.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Mushure mekugadziriswa, chikonzero (murwi haagoni kuuya) chichiri kutaurwa here?
x-e-h2-06.s.s2.modelNote.2: Yakanyora nguva yekupedza se "by the end of this week."

x-e-h2-09.title: Kuwana mamiriro akavanzika mu 'It's cheaper, so let's take the bus'
x-e-h2-09.goal: Sarudza premise isina kutaurwa pakati pechikonzero nemhedziso, uye ugadzire muEnglish mamiriro umo chikonzero chiri chechokwadi asi mhedziso isina kururama.
x-e-h2-09.material:
Mudzidzi wedu Jun anokurudzira nzira yekufamba parwendo rwechikoro kuenda kumuzinda wezvinhu.

Jun: "The bus is cheaper than the subway, so we should take the bus to the museum."

(Izvi ndizvo zvose zvakataurwa naJun. Hapana rumwe ruzivo.)
x-e-h2-09.prereq.1: Mataurirwo ekuenzanisa akaita sa cheap ne slow
x-e-h2-09.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza ma premise ose anofanira kuva echokwadi kuti mhedziso yaJun itevere asi Jun asina kutaura.
x-e-h2-09.s.s1.hint.0: Nyora zvakaparadzana chikonzero chimwe nemhedziso imwe kubva mumutsara waJun.
x-e-h2-09.s.s1.hint.1: Fungidzira nyaya umo mhedziso inochinja kana chikonzero iroro chiri chenhema kana kuti hachina basa.
x-e-h2-09.s.s1.r.a: Ichi chikonzero Jun akatopa kare. Premise yakavanzika chinhu chisina kutaurwa.
x-e-h2-09.s.s1.r.b: Iyi pfungwa yekuti mutengo unofanira kukosha kuti 'it's cheaper' iverengwe sechikonzero.
x-e-h2-09.s.s1.r.c: Kuti musangano wakavhurika here kunodiwa zvakaenzana kubhazi nesubway. Kunobatanidzwa nekusarudza pakati pezvose zviviri here?
x-e-h2-09.s.s1.r.d: Iyi pfungwa yekuti kunyange kana chikonzero chiri chechokwadi, mamwe mamiriro anofanira kushanda kuti mhedziso itevere.
x-e-h2-09.s.s1.explain: Jun haana kuti 'mutengo unokosha' kana 'bhazi harina kuipa zvakanyanya panguva kana kuruka', asi zvose zvinofanira kuva zvechokwadi kuti 'it's cheaper, so the bus' ive mhedziso. a chikonzero chatotaurwa kare, uye c haina chekuita nekusarudza pakati pezvisarudzo zviviri.
x-e-h2-09.s.s2.prompt: Nyora mutsara mumwe kana miviri muEnglish nezvemamiriro umo chikonzero chaJun ('the bus is cheaper') chiri chechokwadi asi mhedziso ('let's take the bus') isina kururama.
x-e-h2-09.s.s2.hint.0: Nyora zvinhu zviviri kunze kwemutengo zvaunofunga nezvazvo kana uchifamba (nguva, kuchengetedzeka, shamwari ine dambudziko remuviri).
x-e-h2-09.s.s2.hint.1: Gadzira mumutsara mumwe mamiriro ebhazi umo chimwe chezvinhu izvi chiri kuipira zvakanyanya.
x-e-h2-09.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Mumamiriro awakanyora, 'the bus is cheaper' ichiri chokwadi here?
x-e-h2-09.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Unogona kutsanangura mumutsara mumwe kuti nei mhedziso isina kururama mumamiriro iwayo?

x-e-h2-10.title: Mushandirapamwe wekudzokorora wakashanda here? Kufunga zvakare nguva imwe neimwe data itsva ichisvika
x-e-h2-10.goal: Tarisa data yakaburitswa mumavhiki matatu, gadzirisa kutonga kwako nguva imwe neimwe, uye utsanangure muEnglish data ipi yakachinja kutonga kwako.
x-e-h2-10.material: Chikoro chakatanga mushandirapamwe wekudzokorora mabhodhoro epurasitiki. Mushandirapamwe usati watanga, avhareji ye120 mabhodhoro pazuva yaiva muzvigaro zvemarara akajairika, uye 10 yaiva muzvigaro zvekudzokorora. Mubvunzo ndewekuti, 'Mushandirapamwe wakashanda here?' Uchatarisa data vhiki rimwe panguva.
x-e-h2-10.prereq.1: Mataurirwo enguva akaita sa at first ne later
x-e-h2-10.s.s1.prompt: Verenga data itsva vhiki rega rega uye usarudze kutonga kwako kusvika zvino.
x-e-h2-10.s.s1.hint.0: Wana nhamba imwe itsva kana chiitiko mudata yevhiki rino.
x-e-h2-10.s.s1.hint.1: Ongorora rimwe nerimwe kana kutonga kwako kwapfuura kuchienderana nedata itsva.
x-e-h2-10.s.s1.st.0.info: Vhiki 1: Mabhodhoro emarara pazuva muzvigaro zvakajairika akadzikira kubva pa120 kusvika pa80.
x-e-h2-10.s.s1.st.0.ask: Kutarisa data yeVhiki 1 oga, kutonga kupi kwakakodzera?
x-e-h2-10.s.s1.st.0.after: Chokwadi kuti mabhodhoro akadzikira muVhiki 1. Panguva ino, zvine musoro kuti zvose uone se 'zvakashanda' uye utaure 'ivhiki rimwe chete, ngatitarisei kwenguva refu.'
x-e-h2-10.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Kutonga uku kunobva pachokwadi chekuti nhamba yakadzikira. Funga futi nezvemuganhu wekuti idata yevhiki rimwe chete.
x-e-h2-10.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Uku kutonga kunochenjerera kunobva pahumbowo, kuchimisa mhedziso yakasimba nokuti idata yevhiki rimwe chete.
x-e-h2-10.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Chokwadi kuti 80 dzinosara, asi unotsanangura sei kuti nhamba yakadzikira kubva pa120?
x-e-h2-10.s.s1.st.1.info: Vhiki 2: Rwendo rwechikoro rwakatora vadzidzi 100 kubva kuvadzidzi 400 kubva neChitatu kusvika neChishanu. Mabhodhoro emarara pazuva: 70.
x-e-h2-10.s.s1.st.1.ask: Ungagadzirisa sei kutonga kwako mushure mekuona ruzivo rutsva?
x-e-h2-10.s.s1.st.1.after: Sezvo nhamba yevadzidzi yakadzikira nechina, hazvigoni kurongwa kana mabhodhoro akadzikira nokuda kwemushandirapamwe kana nokuti vadzidzi vakanga vari vashoma. Kudzikisa kuvimba kwako kwakakodzera.
x-e-h2-10.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Kana mabhodhoro akadzikira muvhiki umo vadzidzi vakanga vari vashoma, ongorora kana mushandirapamwe uri chikonzero chega chekudzikira.
x-e-h2-10.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Kutonga uku kunotorawo mukuongororwa tsananguro imwe, shanduko yenhamba yevadzidzi.
x-e-h2-10.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Kana vadzidzi 100 vasipo, mabhodhoro mashoma angakandwawo. Ongorora kana uyu ruzivo rwaunogona kufuratira.
x-e-h2-10.s.s1.st.2.info: Vhiki 3: Vadzidzi vose vadzoka. Mabhodhoro emarara pazuva: 75. Zvigaro zvekudzokorora zvino zvine mabhodhoro 60 pazuva (zvaive ne10 pazuva mushandirapamwe usati watanga).
x-e-h2-10.s.s1.st.2.ask: Kutonga kupi kunotsigirwa zvakanyanya mushure mekuona data yekupedzisira?
x-e-h2-10.s.s1.st.2.after: Marara 75 + kudzokorora 60 = 135, iyo yakangoita sa 120 + 10 = 130 mushandirapamwe usati watanga. Nhamba yemabhodhoro haina kudzikira, asi kutamira muzvigaro zvekudzokorora ndiko mugumisiro wemushandirapamwe.
x-e-h2-10.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Kutonga uku kwakatarisa chokwadi chekuti nhamba haisi padhuze ne0 chete. Unoverenga sei nhamba iri muzvigaro zvekudzokorora?
x-e-h2-10.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Kana ukatarisa zvigaro zvemarara chete, nhamba yakadzikira, asi enzanisa huwandu hwose hunosanganisira zvigaro zvekudzokorora (75+60 ne120+10).
x-e-h2-10.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Uku kutonga kunoenzanisa huwandu hwezvigaro zvemarara nezvekudzokorora pamwe chete.
x-e-h2-10.s.s1.reflect: Kutonga kwako kwakachinja sei kubva muvhiki kuenda kuvhiki? Kana kwakachinja, taura data imwe (mutsara mumwe) yakazvikonzera.
x-e-h2-10.s.s2.prompt: Nyora mitsara 2 kusvika ku3 muEnglish nezvekuti kutonga kwako kwakachinja sei. Taura kuti data yevhiki ripi yakachinja pfungwa dzako.
x-e-h2-10.s.s2.hint.0: Nyora mutsara mumwe wesarudzo yawakasarudza vhiki rega rega, uye umake kwakachinja.
x-e-h2-10.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Unogona kuona kutonga kwako kwekutanga, chikonzero chawakazunguzika pakati, nekutonga kwako kwekupedzisira here?
x-e-h2-10.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Kutonga kwako kwekupedzisira kunotsigirwa nenhamba dziri mudata yeVhiki 3 here?
x-e-h2-10.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Panzvimbo pekutaura 'zvechokwadi', wakashandisa chiyero chekuvimba chinoenderana nedata here?
